source._comment: Virginia has no party registration -> turnout-only. VPAP publishes a Nov-2026-general early-vote-by-US-House-district TopoJSON on S3 (objects[].properties: district, ballots, mail_ballots, in_person, vpap_index[_description], candidates). We discover the dataset URL from the visual page at runtime (VPAP bumps the dated S3 path when it re-cuts the file) and fall back to dataset_url. This is per-CD turnout, split into by-mail (mail_voted) and in-person (early_voted); no partisan breakdown of the ballots (VA doesn't tag ballots by party).
